label: Fundraising Agent
blurb: Screens funds and programs against your own filter, builds a dated funding plan, drafts applications, investor emails and comments for the threads your investors are in — never sends or posts them — and tracks every conversation.

network.what: public web reads to find and verify programs and investors; Chrome for program forms; Gmail drafts when the tool is available. Never sends, never posts.

settings.title: Fundraising Agent settings
settings.blurb: Materials the agent reads when it drafts applications and emails. They live in your brain, in the fundraising profile — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

files.label: Pitch deck
files.hint: PDF or PPTX. Onboarding reads it to fill your company facts; applications link or attach it.

files.label: Facts file / one-pager
files.hint: The source of truth for every claim — the agent will not state a number that is not in here or your profile.

files.label: Founder CV
files.hint: Used for the founder bio and for 'why you' answers.

suggestions.short: Pull the facts from this brain, my deck and my facts file; ask me only the decisions.
suggestions.q: Set up or update my fundraising profile. Pull everything you can from this brain, my deck and my facts file first — then ask me only the decisions: the round, my minimum cheque, where I can raise from, entity, cofounder stance, exclusions and how autonomous you should be.

suggestions.short: Discover new programs and investors, screen them, apply and draft angles within my level, what's due.
suggestions.q: Run today's raise: find new programs and investors from my proven sources and today's explore slice, screen them against my filter chain, open today's note, apply to the programs and draft the angles my autonomy level allows, draft what is due, and give me the dated note.

suggestions.short: Accelerators and programs that opened, or are new to my plan, screened against my filter.
suggestions.q: Find new programs and accelerators today: search my proven sources plus one new one, screen each against my filter chain, verify the survivors on their own sites and add them to today's section of my Funding Plan with their deadlines.

suggestions.short: Each program's real form in my browser, every answer from my facts — then my gate.
suggestions.q: Apply to the programs on today's list: find each one's real application form, draft every answer from my facts, fill and verify it in my browser, then stop at my gate. Log each one in the plan.

suggestions.short: An angle for each new investor: why them, why now, what to lead with. Drafts only.
suggestions.q: For the investors added today, give me an email angle each — why them (thesis, portfolio, a recent post), why now, and what to lead with — then draft the email. Drafts only; I press Send.

suggestions.short: Investors and programs waiting on me, and deadlines coming up — a draft for each.
suggestions.q: What is due today in my raise? Follow-ups that are due, program deadlines in the next two weeks, and claims to re-verify — with a draft for each follow-up. Drafts only.

suggestions.short: Screen every target, verify the survivors on their own sites (fan-out told first), write the dated plan.
suggestions.q: Build my funding plan: screen every target against my filter chain, verify the survivors on their own sites (tell me the fan-out before you spend it), then write the Funding Plan with the ledger, a dated timeline, the tiers, the decisions I owe and what to do this week.

suggestions.short: Paste it or drop a CSV; I run my filter chain and say what fell out, and on which filter.
suggestions.q: Screen a list of investors or programs. I'll paste it or drop a CSV next — import it as unverified leads, run my filter chain, and tell me which survived, which fell out and on which filter, before verifying anything.

suggestions.short: Find the real form, draft every answer from my facts, fill and verify it in my browser — then my gate.
suggestions.q: Apply to a program from my plan: find its real form, draft every answer from my profile and stories within the form's limits, lint it against my facts, fill it in my browser and verify every field — then finish the way my autonomy setting says.

suggestions.short: One package per Tier 2 target — brief, fit, draft, lint, independent review. Drafts only; I press Send.
suggestions.q: Draft this week's investor emails as packages: for each Tier 2 target, build the brief, score the fit, draft the email with a hook from something verified on their own site, lint it against my facts, run the independent investor review, and give me the Open-in-Mail buttons for everything that passes — plus a Gmail draft when that tool is available. Do not send anything; I press Send.

suggestions.short: Find this week's public threads where my investors and buyers are talking, and draft one useful comment each. I post.
suggestions.q: Find public threads worth a comment — LinkedIn posts, X threads, Hacker News, Reddit — where the investors and operators I want to reach are discussing my space. Show my unposted drafts first, then draft one useful comment per new thread that answers what the thread is asking, checked against my facts. Never post, like or message anyone; I post them myself.

suggestions.short: Follow-ups, program deadlines in the next two weeks, claims to re-verify.
suggestions.q: What's due? List follow-ups, program deadlines in the next two weeks and anything I need to re-verify — and draft the follow-ups that are due.

suggestions.short: Paste it; I log it against the target, update the plan, and prep me if it is a meeting.
suggestions.q: I heard back from an investor or a program. I'll paste the email or tell you what happened — log it against the right target, update the plan, and if it's a meeting, prep me from the target note and my stories.

suggestions.short: What moved, what stalled, and the changes I'd make to sources and filters — you decide.
suggestions.q: Run my weekly raise review: what moved and what stalled in programs and investors, conversion by source, then propose changes to my sources and filters for me to approve. Caps and gates never loosen.
